title: NodeRelation payload
description: Output of the PRD §40.7 `extractRelations(normalised)` boundary. Feeds the immutable corpus `node_relation` table (PRD §35.2).

relation_type.description: PRD §15.1 relation taxonomy. NOT constrained to an enum here: packages/contracts publishes no `RelationType` family yet (Q-CRPS-4 / FND-03).

evidence_ref.description: The node version whose text evidences the relation. Required whenever an offset range is given.

derivation.description: How the relation was derived — the parser rule, heuristic or model that produced it.

confidence_state.description: PRD §35.2: `MODEL_SUGGESTED` cannot support definitive status. NOT constrained to an enum here: packages/contracts publishes no `ConfidenceState` family yet (Q-CRPS-4 / FND-03); `validate_record()` enforces the MODEL_SUGGESTED rule in the meantime (violation MODEL_SUGGESTED_DEFINITIVE).
